title: The sculptures gone — Mary and Juanita, the city, the drawer
status: waits for: Nurse Mary + Juanita's audition
text:
Carefully she plucks everything out of the trash can where it has been carelessly intermingled with the other trash. Just as she finishes, the sculptures carefully collected in the crook of her arm, Nurse Mary and a Mexican cleaning lady appear in her doorway.  
“No. This is *trash.* Juanita is going to clean everything up for you.” Nurse Mary disappears into the hallway and Sophie looks panic-stricken and speedwalks back to her room.   
spoons are broken into pieces, glued to the wall with masking tape. She’s taken the wrapping from a plastic knife and draped it in such a way that a small mess of salt packets hang from it. Each has been adorned with a blurb from the calendar provided with her meal menu every morning. “1:30 therapeutic music group.” says one serrated segment which has been separated carefully from its brothers without the use of scissors.  
	“There.” The nurse points at the wall, looking back at the cleaning lady for disapproval.  
	“She eez a genius!” whispers the cleaning lady “She eez makeeng...an entire city.” The cleaning lady looks at Sophie in wonder.  
	“Yes, exactly what I was thinking,” says nurse Mary uncertainly. “Yes, but it *is *trash,” she says, walking over to her desk and pulling open the top drawer. A collection of carefully cleaned and dried half-and-half cups, salt packets and more blurbs from the calendar, all carefully torn along the edges.  
	“But why do you make your room so messy?” asks the cleaning lady. Sophie giggles in spite of herself. “That’s what I...made the city out of…” she looks at the drawer, and then back at the cleaning lady, hiding a tiny smile. then she closes the drawer.  
  
  
  
“You’re right. I’ll clean it up in a minute.”   
	“Ok,” says the cleaning lady, and smiles at Sophie who beams back at her. Nurse Mary leaves without a backward glance.  
	As soon as they’re gone, Sophie pulls everything out of the drawer, wraps it in a spare uniform, and hides it under her bed.

title: Climax 6 — the hall breakdown
videos: the doctor and the assistant (hall b-roll, head on, 4s)
text:
Sophie walks back out the door of her room, the assistant trailing behind her, discreetly jotting things down on her clipboard. Her eyes are welling with tears and she is still tearing at her hair.  
  
 “I don’t know what i’m supposed to do.” she looks around frantically - her eyes taking in the narrow hallway, a beige fire detector on the ceiling, the locked doors in front of her.  
  
the nurse nods sympathetically, looking up from her clipboard for a split second.  
  
“I can’t do this anymore,” she says softly, her voice cracking midway through every word.  
  
the nurse nods, muttering a non commital “hmm”  
  
“maybe i am crazy.” she, sophie, finally considers, to herself.  
  
the nurse nods again.  
  
“just like i always wanted,” she whispers.  
  
The assistant, who’s been trailing her closely, nodding as she puts forth every word, pauses at the last sentence as though stung. “What you’ve always wanted?”  
  
“Yes,” says Sophie,” “I’ve always wanted to lose my mind.” she says slowly  
  
she stops in the middle of the hallway. The assistant steps backwards, her auburn ponytail caught in itself and for once unkempt. She writes something down on her clipboard, then backs away slowly, without turning around.
